```python
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import t

data = np.loadtxt(
    "code/data/support-regression.csv",
    delimiter=",",
    skiprows=1,
)
x, y = data[:, 1], data[:, 2]
n = x.size

x_mean, y_mean = x.mean(), y.mean()
sxx = np.sum((x - x_mean) ** 2)
sxy = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean))
b1 = sxy / sxx
b0 = y_mean - b1 * x_mean

fitted = b0 + b1 * x
residuals = y - fitted
residual_std = np.sqrt(np.sum(residuals**2) / (n - 2))
r = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]
r_squared = 1 - np.sum(residuals**2) / np.sum((y - y_mean) ** 2)

se_b1 = residual_std / np.sqrt(sxx)
t_statistic = b1 / se_b1
p_value = 2 * t.sf(abs(t_statistic), df=n - 2)

alpha = 0.05
t_critical = t.ppf(1 - alpha / 2, df=n - 2)
slope_interval = (
    b1 - t_critical * se_b1,
    b1 + t_critical * se_b1,
)

x0 = 45
prediction = b0 + b1 * x0
se_mean = residual_std * np.sqrt(1 / n + (x0 - x_mean) ** 2 / sxx)
se_prediction = residual_std * np.sqrt(
    1 + 1 / n + (x0 - x_mean) ** 2 / sxx
)
mean_interval = (
    prediction - t_critical * se_mean,
    prediction + t_critical * se_mean,
)
prediction_interval = (
    prediction - t_critical * se_prediction,
    prediction + t_critical * se_prediction,
)

print(f"ŷ = {b0:.4f} + {b1:.4f}x")
print(f"r = {r:.4f}; R² = {r_squared:.4f}")
print(f"t = {t_statistic:.2f}; p = {p_value:.3e}")
print("95%-й ДИ для b₁:", np.round(slope_interval, 4))
print(f"Прогноз при x₀ = {x0}: {prediction:.4f}")
print("95%-й ДИ среднего:", np.round(mean_interval, 4))
print("95%-й предиктивный интервал:", np.round(prediction_interval, 4))
```
